head: Eric Schmidt and Reed Hastings gave 73% of the personal gifts from 22 named donors to committees linked to sitting members.
deck: Deepens “The arrival,” which counted Anthropic’s employees and its PAC: the two largest personal givers on the wider roster are an investor and a director. Their receipts here start years before Anthropic announced those roles.
note: Each gift is counted once at first receipt, before refunds. A gift is not a vote.
